title: Tip deflection of the reference cantilever (FEA family v1)
objective: Verify that the incompatible-modes solve reproduces the Euler-Bernoulli tip deflection of the reference steel cantilever within the validated band.

qoi.name: tip displacement
qoi.definition: the maximum |u3| over the printed nodes — the tip deflection of the transversely loaded cantilever
qoi.how_extracted: returned by the wrapper on every valid run; the requested number per the contract's quantity key

success_criterion.statement: The coarse-mesh tip deflection exceeds 0.0029 m (within ~5% of the Euler-Bernoulli value 0.0030476 m, approaching from below).

regime.notes: Slender reference beam (L/h = 20 >= 10, F1), small deflection (delta/L ~ 0.3% <= 10%, F2); the requested QoI is the validated tip_displacement, not the reported-only stress.

mini_experiment.expected_observation: tip_displacement 0.003003 -> 0.003029 m across mesh 8 -> 16, converging toward the Euler-Bernoulli 0.0030476 m from below.

full_experiment.design: The three-rung refinement ladder (mesh 8/16/32), comparing each tip deflection to the closed form.
